services.name: Guitar repair
services.story: The main story: a guitar that buzzes on the low strings. Only the $25 inspection is promised. Mina's written estimate is OK'd before any work, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Restring
services.story: A $35 restring from the shop's board. Nothing is taken: a YES books it. Alex pays at the counter.

services.name: Guitar repair
services.story: The same guitar repair, with the bill texted once it's ready, so Alex can pay before pick-up.

services.name: Woodwind overhaul
services.story: A $140 woodwind overhaul, a long repair. A $40 deposit books the bench time, and the $100 rest is paid at the counter.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Owen and Lena (piano tuners and repair repair techs)

services.name: Piano tuning
services.story: The main story: a $179 piano tuning at Alex's home. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee, charged only for a late cancel or a no-show, and only on Sam's yes. Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Piano repair
services.story: A piano with sticking keys, priced at the visit. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee.

services.name: Piano tuning
services.story: The $179 piano tuning. A card is saved, and charged when Owen texts DONE.

services.name: Band room repair
services.story: A school band room repair, priced from photos and the list of instruments at $640. Sam OKs it. A $160 deposit orders the parts, and the rest is on the bill.
